}}'''Kirin Melway''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|922}}.

==History==
Kirin held the position for twenty-eight years until her death in {{Ne|950}}. She was [[Aleis Romlin]]'s successor and [[Noane Masadim]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Kirin was a quite weak Amyrlin, though not so lacking in influence and strength as her predecessor Aleis. In truth many of the things she did helped pave the way for some stronger Amyrlin to come after her.

[[Verin Mathwin]] last made a serious mistake during Kirin's reign. This was probably her choice betwen joining the [[Black Ajah]] or die. {{Ref/book|8|prologue}}

[[Vandene]] and [[Adeleas]] retired at some point durign Kirin's reign, most likely in the late 920s. {{Ref/book|2|22}}

At least two of the [[Kin]], [[Zarya Alkaese]] and [[Sarainya Vostovan]], ran away or were sent away during Kirin's reign. {{Ref/book|7|24}}
